name: Grama New Project Launch Template
status: Reusable draft template, not a project approval
useExisting: Map existing Project IDs, folders and sheet URLs first. Reuse the existing Source Map / Plan / Controls structure. No automatic sheets or agents.

recordPolicy.keys: Project ID + Template Task Key. Re-running a launch updates existing mapped rows after approval; never blind append.
recordPolicy.ownerPolicy: One responsible person per action. PM coordination does not appoint counsel/engineer/field staff. Construction staffing confirmed before release.
recordPolicy.sourcePolicy: A source link or Verified live metadata is not a signed approval, paid invoice or verified scope.
recordPolicy.activation: Only work with confirmed owner, source, due/follow-up, resolved dependencies and appropriate authority becomes Ready. A launch draft never authorizes purchases, contracts, permits or payments.

tasks.task: Identify opportunity and check duplicates
tasks.definitionOfDone: Site identity, alias check, source, intended use and project ID

tasks.task: Verify title, legal description and acquisition terms
tasks.definitionOfDone: Current title/ownership, legal description, access, contract dates and unresolved issues

tasks.task: Verify survey and site constraints
tasks.definitionOfDone: Survey revision; easements; soils/environmental/drainage constraints and missing investigations

tasks.task: Test use, yield and program alternatives
tasks.definitionOfDone: Supported buildable area, proposed units/areas and alternatives; assumptions labeled

tasks.task: Validate sales or rental basis
tasks.definitionOfDone: Comparable market evidence with adjustments, dates and selling assumptions

tasks.task: Build cost, cash and downside feasibility
tasks.definitionOfDone: Acquisition-to-exit costs, funding timing, downside and missing inputs; fee counted once

tasks.task: Agree entity, funding, roles and authority
tasks.definitionOfDone: Ownership, capital, fees/profit, draw terms and commitment authority

tasks.task: Coordinate and execute required agreements
tasks.definitionOfDone: Applicable executed documents and approval record before commitments

tasks.task: Confirm zoning and entitlement path
tasks.definitionOfDone: Agency-backed requirements, conditions, submissions and expiry dates

tasks.task: Set design program and drawing control
tasks.definitionOfDone: Current program, above-grade/basement/garage units, plan revision and reference/reuse rights

tasks.task: Coordinate survey, civil, structural and MEP
tasks.definitionOfDone: Coordinated design releases and assumptions; comment ownership

tasks.task: Track permits and review comments
tasks.definitionOfDone: Separate submission, correction, approval, expiry and inspection conditions

tasks.task: Track each utility and offsite requirement
tasks.definitionOfDone: Application, design, capacity, easement, owner work, quote, installation and activation

tasks.task: Measure quantities and build cost-code estimate
tasks.definitionOfDone: Drawing takeoff, quantity basis, labor/material/equipment/subcontract scope and exclusions

tasks.task: Level bids and reconcile complete scope
tasks.definitionOfDone: Comparable quotes, exclusions, tax/freight, validity, lead times and unpriced work

tasks.task: Approve budget, contingency and funding baseline
tasks.definitionOfDone: Reconciled original budget and cash forecast; assumptions and approval receipt

tasks.task: Authorize contracts and purchase orders
tasks.definitionOfDone: Approved package, supplier scope, committed amount, delivery and approval

tasks.task: Build master schedule and lookahead
tasks.definitionOfDone: Evidence-based durations, predecessors, procurement and inspections; baseline vs forecast

tasks.task: Verify release-to-build readiness
tasks.definitionOfDone: Required permits, drawings, access, resources, inspection and safety responsibility

tasks.task: Track progress, quality and inspections
tasks.definitionOfDone: Daily progress, quantities, inspection evidence, quality issues and forecast

tasks.task: Control RFIs and cost/schedule changes
tasks.definitionOfDone: Issue, proposed change, impacted scope, cost and dates; decision recorded

tasks.task: Reconcile incurred costs and cost-to-complete
tasks.definitionOfDone: Actual incurred + remaining commitment + uncommitted work + unallocated risk = EAC

tasks.task: Review cash, funding and payment requests
tasks.definitionOfDone: Capital contributions, receipts, cash paid, AP and refundable security tracked separately

tasks.task: Complete inspections, punch list and turnover
tasks.definitionOfDone: Applicable occupancy/acceptance, punch list, manuals, releases and warranties

tasks.task: Close sale or lease and reconcile distributions
tasks.definitionOfDone: Supported settlement, final project costs, capital return and agreed profit distribution

tasks.task: Assign warranty and security-release obligations
tasks.definitionOfDone: Issue process, remaining service obligations, security release conditions and owners

tasks.task: Archive evidence and reusable cost lessons
tasks.definitionOfDone: Final reconciliation, complete evidence links, closeout lessons and normalized historical costs

tasks.task: Define shared infrastructure and lot release gates
tasks.definitionOfDone: Parent development plus child lot IDs; dependencies for starts/occupancy

tasks.task: Approve shared-cost allocation and portfolio elimination
tasks.definitionOfDone: Shared-site costs assigned once; approved lot allocation and no parent/child double counting

financeRules: Unknown amounts remain null, not zero.
A selected subcontract price replaces its covered component calculation.
EAC = incurred actual + remaining commitments + uncommitted forecast + unallocated risk; eliminate allocated contingency from unallocated risk.
Investment contributions and capital returns are separate from project costs and revenue.
Refundable securities affect cash; expense treatment requires support.
Shared-site costs and allocated lot costs cannot both enter consolidated total.

agentTaskBrief.handoff: Sources, decisions, result, open gaps, next action and owner

pilotAcceptance: Use one real project package to trace takeoff, quote, budget, draft commitment, EAC and schedule.
Change a disposable test input and verify forecast changes while approved baseline stays fixed.
Launch a second project without copying pilot names, prices, terms, sources or dates.
Verify source-to-closure evidence and owner access.
